observation: one iid full strict directed order per sample; arbitrary vertex enumeration supplies no latent coordinates or ranks
class: original InDensityClass in QuantyraNullCone/Model.lean; full K
symmetry: one global identity or coordinate transpose for all claims
prerequisites: Primary-source comparison and a specific contribution disposition
Explicit K-membership verification for all benchmark formulas
Valid full-K finite coverage argument and independently checkable certificate contract
Fixed pre-sample allocation/tuning or a proved simultaneous-selection event
Independent evaluator using analytic cell extrema, one shared orientation and no estimator access to latent data
Host can enforce timeout and total process-tree RSS limits

pilot.purpose: Find implementation/resource problems and select one mathematically justified candidate; not confirmation evidence

confirmation.nonexecuted_comparator: flat estimate 1, error <=1/2, full-range bands of width 1
confirmation.optional_oracles: known coordinates/ranks only for labeled diagnostics; excluded from order-only success

practical_continue_threshold.interpretation: prespecified operational research threshold; not a confidence statement about typical performance or minimax optimality

resource_limits.total_time_accounting: sum of all run durations, including pilot, confirmation, oracle diagnostics and memory repeats
resource_limits.on_exhaustion: stop, retain partial manifest and failures, return resource no-go; never infer an information limit

intermediate_results_are_not_success: mean width improvement with full worst-case width
amendment_rule: Preserve version 1; date and explain any amendment and freeze it before fresh confirmation samples. No silent cap, model or endpoint changes.
lean_handoff: separately selected certification after a stable substantive result; every Lean/Lake invocation on remote GCP
